scope: 기존 공식 Action Genome train 500영상 부분집합에서 로컬 미실행 아이디어 전이

method_definitions.local_temporal: 4-step temporal attention direct future head plus current auxiliary target
method_definitions.local_memory: train-only class-conditional relation mean blended 0.5 into observed history, anchored residual head
method_definitions.local_masked: 25% random history timestep masking during training, last timestep retained, anchored residual head
method_definitions.local_mtp: anchored residual plus actual earlier future timestep auxiliary prediction
method_definitions.local_rank: anchored residual plus positive-negative relation ranking softplus loss weight0.1
method_definitions.local_macro: anchored residual with inverse-square-root train-positive class frequency weighted BCE auxiliary and future loss

control_weights: 기존 development 및 final 동결 weights 재사용; 신규 재학습 없음
selection: mode별 development NC@20 mR 증가와 R 비하락 동시 만족; 미충족시 baseline 유지
after_selection: 신규6방법 전체500 eligible로 refit 후 동결, 공식 test 전조건 진단평가; dev탈락방법은 채택표시금지
test: SGCLS/predcls, observation0.3/0.5/0.7/0.9, WC/NC, official evaluator IoU0
inference: 관측 prefix 및 동결 train memory만; 미래GT는 평가target만. SGCLS관측bbox/예측class, predcls관측bbox/class 허용
symbolic_FDSG_and_OOTSM: 이미 완료된 별도조건 원본 결과 보존; 이번 신규 시각특징 전이실험에서 다시학습하지 않음
